name: night-shift
description: Goodnight and Goodmorning above the prompt: hand the session to Claude as your co-pilot overnight (it decides, logs every decision, keeps going within red lines and a spend cap), then get a full morning report. A sunrise or deep-ocean bar above the prompt with the Goodnight | Goodmorning switch attached inside it, a 4 s cancel window, and a usage row with context and plan meters.

nightCap.title: Night spend cap (US$)
nightCap.description: Claude usage the night shift may spend before it stops itself

maxTurns.title: Night turn limit
maxTurns.description: Most auto-continued turns in one night, as a safety stop

logFolder.title: Night log folder
logFolder.description: Where the night log and the morning report are written. Empty: a .night-shift folder in the session's project folder.

showStrip.title: Show the strip
showStrip.description: Draw the day/night strip above the prompt (the /goodnight and /goodmorning commands work either way)

usageRow.title: Usage row
usageRow.description: Draw the context and plan-window meters, with a Compact button, in the same look as the strip (if you use the skins mod, turn its own band row off to avoid two)
